dict.string: holzBar sees which of your paired Bluetooth devices are connected, so automation rules and accessory alerts can react to it. It never connects to a device, scans for devices or sends anything to one.
holzBar shows your next events and their meeting links in the notch hub. It reads them on this Mac only and never sends or stores them.
holzBar watches your Downloads folder for downloads in progress, to show them at the notch. It never reads what you download.
holzBar reads the name of the Wi-Fi network you are connected to, so an automation rule can react to it. It does not read your location.
